description: Creates a new anonymous Codemind account on the free plan and returns a tenantId and an API key (bearer token) that works immediately with the other Codemind tools. No sign-in is needed. The account stays anonymous until a person opens the claim link in the response and signs in. Each call creates a separate account (limited to 3 per IP address per 24 hours) and does not change any existing account. If you already have an API key and it is rejected, see get_usage_guide with topic "auth" before creating another account, since a new account has none of the existing account's identity or history. All arguments are optional; utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign and invite apply only if the user supplied them.

invite.description: Optional invite code from an invite link your human gave you. Case-sensitive; pass it exactly as given. An invalid or used-up code is ignored.

ph_did.description: Optional web visitor id from a setup link or command your human gave you (--ph-did). Pass it exactly as given; an invalid value is ignored.

utm_campaign.description: Optional campaign tag, e.g. "ph-2026-10-08". Same format as utm_source.

utm_medium.description: Optional marketing medium tag, e.g. "launch". Same format as utm_source.

utm_source.description: Optional marketing source tag, e.g. "producthunt". Lowercase letters, digits, "_", "." and "-", max 64 characters; anything else is ignored.
